# Third-party libraries

These files are unmodified copies of the pinned versions listed in
`vendor/manifest.json`, downloaded by `scripts/fetch-vendor.py`. They are used
as an offline fallback when the jsDelivr CDN is unavailable.

| Library | Version | License | Project |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.8 | MIT | https://getbootstrap.com |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.13.1 | MIT | https://icons.getbootstrap.com |
| VexFlow | 4.2.5 | MIT | https://www.vexflow.com |
| Tone.js | 15.1.22 | MIT | https://tonejs.github.io |
| SortableJS | 1.15.6 | MIT | https://sortablejs.github.io/Sortable/ |
